kebab_example: aliyun cc5g delete-authorization-rule --wireless-cloud-connector-id cc5g-xxxx --authorization-rule-id ar5g-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAuthorizationRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the 5G cloud instance
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the authorization rule
parameters.name: authorization_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without deleting the authorization rule. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether the request complies with business limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the authorization rule is deleted immediately
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除授权规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接删除授权规则
parameters.name: dry_run
